provenance.contents: Inputs drawn with numpy's default_rng and the outputs of ctxcore run on them in a separate environment. Only outputs are recorded; no ctxcore code is part of CyteArc.
provenance.inputs: rankings holds zero-based ranks of the signature genes (columns) in each motif's ranking (rows) of totalGenes genes, passed to ctxcore as a DataFrame. The enrichment database is a FeatherRankingDatabase whose motifs rank all totalGenes genes: the signature genes at the stored ranks and the other genes at the remaining ranks. The signature is a GeneSignature of genes and weights.

calls.enrichment.auc: The (Enrichment, AUC) column of enrichment4features(database, signature, rankThreshold, aucThreshold), in motifs order
calls.enrichment.nes: The (Enrichment, NES) column of the same call
calls.enrichment.leadingEdges: leading_edge(curve, envelope, ranking, genes, weights) for each motif with NES at least nesThreshold, sorted by decreasing NES; curves from recovery(rankings, totalGenes, weights, rankThreshold, aucThreshold) and the envelope their mean plus two population standard deviations at each rank
